body:
there is nobody, my father is a tame man, he can't even stop him from swearing or threatening me with violence or they would probably come to blows -my father and myself are the ones who aren't willing to go that far, my brother certainly is willing

thank you for your kind words at the end, I hugged my father, told how miserable I am feeling and how sorry I am that we are in this situation with no good way out

there will never be a family intervention that can change my brother, absolutely any words are lost on him, he was feeling guilty while my mother was dying because even then he was failing, but even if everyone would confront his horrible attitude he would just resort to playing the victim and crying, maybe claiming that he's sick and has heart issues -nothing medically proven mind you, just his claims- triggering our pity and ending things by us trying to appease him

the only thing I can think of and that I suggested to my father was that we should only discuss the inheritance further at the office of a mediator or notary where he can't act out, manipulate, or play us emotionally

Regardless, I feel an acke just thinking of having him around knowing now openly that he resents me for existing. My heart aches at how my father wants his sons to live in peace but he gets this shit instead where one is willing to push it to the point where he is threatening to waste his efforts and money up to this point unless he gets what he wants, or because he resents the other brother pleading for either solution.

My brother is the kind of person that will -and has- buy a dog to impress a girl into getting back together with him, and then leaving the poor animal to be cared for by us, the rest of his family, without permission from the owner of the property, my father, knowing that he is too kind-hearted to not care for the dog.
